titles.english: Thunderbolt Fantasy: The Sword of Life and Death

description:
Movie adaptation of Thunderbolt Fantasy sidestory novels, split into two parts. The first part tells the backstory of the Screaming Phoenix Killer, Shā Wú Shēng and the second part features a Shāng Bù Huàn story set between Thunderbolt Fantasy seasons 1 and 2.

(Source: Anime News Network)
